name: Notion
whatYouLose: Real-time multiplayer editing with presence and conflict-free merges
Offline-capable desktop and mobile apps with sync
Databases with relations, rollups and dozens of views
Permissions, sharing, public pages, comments and an integration ecosystem
Years of edge-case polish in the block editor
prompt:
Build a personal block-based notes app (a narrow Notion-like tool for one person).

Stack: Vite + vanilla TS, Tiptap editor, SQLite via a small Node API.
Features:
- Nested pages in a sidebar tree with drag to reorder.
- Block editor: headings, lists, to-dos, code blocks, quotes, images (uploaded to disk), slash command menu.
- Simple databases: a page can be a table with typed columns (text, number, select, date, checkbox) and a board view grouped by a select column.
- Full-text search across pages (SQLite FTS5).
- Markdown export of any page.
Done when: one person can take notes, nest pages and track a small board. Multiplayer is explicitly out of scope.
notes: You can build a nice single-player notes app in one prompt. You cannot build Notion: the value is collaboration, sync and the long tail of polish.
